name: Limit Journal 3
definition: Record where all transactions are originally entered. The journal details which transactions occurred and what accounts were affected.

Limit.name: Limit
Limit.definition: Maximum value used for risk containment in a system or towards counterparts. The limit may be a current limit or a default limit.

JournalActivityDate.name: Journal Activity Date
JournalActivityDate.definition: Date upon which journal activity takes place.

JournalEntry.name: Journal Entry
JournalEntry.definition: Recording of transaction data pertaining to a transaction in a journal.
